title: nf-core/gwas pipeline - summary-statistics manifest schema
description: Schema for the summary-statistics manifest provided with params.summary_statistics_manifest. One row declares one external or pipeline-generated scientific summary result.

summary_statistics_id.description: Unique stable identifier for the canonical summary-statistics result.
summary_statistics_id.errorMessage: Summary-statistics ID must be provided, must be unique and cannot contain spaces

trait_id.description: Declared trait identifier represented by this summary-statistics result.
trait_id.errorMessage: Trait ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces

trait_type.description: Declared trait type, which is never inferred from summary-statistics values.
trait_type.errorMessage: Trait type must be one of 'quantitative' or 'binary'

source.description: External raw or canonical source summary-statistics table; blank for a pipeline-generated result.
source.errorMessage: Source must be a readable .tsv, .txt or .csv table, optionally gzip-compressed, and cannot contain spaces

source_mode.description: Whether an external source requires GWASLab harmonisation or already asserts the canonical contract; blank for a pipeline-generated result.
source_mode.errorMessage: Source mode must be one of 'raw' or 'canonical'

source_format.description: GWASLab input-format name for external raw input or nfcore_gwas_canonical_v1 for external canonical input; blank for a pipeline-generated result.
source_format.errorMessage: Source format must be a single GWASLab format token or 'nfcore_gwas_canonical_v1'

producer_analysis_id.description: Analysis identifier that produces an internal summary result; blank for an external result.
producer_analysis_id.errorMessage: Producer analysis ID cannot contain spaces

producer_association_method.description: Association method selected by the producer analysis; blank for an external result.
producer_association_method.errorMessage: Producer association method must be one lowercase method token

genome_build.description: Declared human reference build of an external source; derived from the producer analysis for an internal result.
genome_build.errorMessage: Genome build must be one of 'GRCh37' or 'GRCh38'

ancestry.description: Researcher-declared ancestry or population provenance label for an external source; derived for an internal result.
ancestry.errorMessage: Ancestry must be provided and cannot contain spaces

source_method.description: Method or program that produced an external source; derived from producer_association_method for an internal result.
source_method.errorMessage: Source method must be provided and cannot contain spaces

source_release.description: Optional study, dataset or software release associated with the source.
source_release.errorMessage: Source release must be one token without spaces

heritability_methods.description: Optional comma-delimited unary summary-statistics methods selected for this result.
heritability_methods.errorMessage: Heritability methods must be a comma-delimited list of lowercase tokens with no spaces

population_prevalence.description: Optional population prevalence for a binary trait.
population_prevalence.errorMessage: Population prevalence must be a number strictly between 0 and 1

sample_prevalence.description: Optional sample case fraction for a binary trait.
sample_prevalence.errorMessage: Sample prevalence must be a number strictly between 0 and 1

access_constraints.description: Optional non-secret access or redistribution constraint recorded in provenance.
access_constraints.errorMessage: Access constraints must be one line and must not contain credentials
